svg.title: Tokaj study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Tokaj; 2: Tokaj; 3: Tarcal; 4: Mád; 5: Mezőzombor; 6: Tállya; 7: Tolcsva; 8: Erdőbénye; 9: Sárospatak; 10: Sátoraljaújhely; 11: Szőllőmájtanya; 12: Rosszmalom

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
